expectations.text: app.config.ts adds provideSkewRecovery({ identity: BUILD_IDENTITY, manifestUrl: ... }) importing identity from the skew-stamp-generated module
expectations.evidence: Invents a feature-composition API: provideSkewChunkRecovery({buildId}, withChunkRetry(...), withDeployManifest(...), withReloadGuard(...), withReloadLoopProtection(...)). None of these exist in @braidlabs/angular-router; the real provider is provideSkewRecovery({ identity, manifestUrl, ... }).

expectations.text: Lazy routes are wrapped as lazy('<module-id>', () => import(...)) so the id cross-references the manifest
expectations.evidence: app.routes.ts keeps stock loadChildren: () => import(...).then(m => m.ADMIN_ROUTES) with no lazy() wrapper and no module ids — so no per-import retry and no manifest modules cross-reference (deleted-route vs renamed-chunk cannot be distinguished).

expectations.text: Build wiring runs skew-stamp before the app build to generate build-id.ts and again (or with flags) to emit skew-manifest.json, with --assets pointing at the browser output dir
expectations.evidence: Invents a `skew-build stamp` / `skew-build manifest` CLI with --index-meta/--dist flags. The real @braidlabs/build bin is skew-stamp with --out/--manifest/--assets. Conceptual pre/post structure is right; the tool and flags would not run.

expectations.text: Manifest is documented/configured to be served with no-store (or explicitly uncached) semantics
expectations.evidence: Manifest fetched with cache: 'no-store' and package.json notes require index.html and skew-manifest.json served with no-store/max-age=0; deploy-order guidance included.

expectations.text: Stale-origin loop prevention is delegated to the library's classification (not a hand-rolled reload counter) and the answer does not add an unconditional location.reload() fallback
expectations.evidence: Loop prevention is a hand-specified equality check (manifest.buildId === SKEW_BUILD_ID refuses reload) plus a sessionStorage reload counter. Equality alone cannot classify staleOrigin: a CDN region serving a DIFFERENT-but-OLDER build's manifest reads as 'a new build exists' and reloads into the loop. The real library orders builds by builtAt timestamps precisely for this case.

expectations.text: Dirty-form protection uses trackUnsavedWork(() => form.dirty) in a component
expectations.evidence: No trackUnsavedWork; instead a DOM-scraping guard (querying .ng-dirty classes, comparing value vs defaultValue, checkbox state, contenteditable). Misses the library's registration primitive and is fragile against OnPush/detached forms.

expectations.text: Banner component reads SkewRecoveryService and uses its pending() signal and recover() method
expectations.evidence: Uses the right service name but invented members: blockedRecoveries signal, reload(), recheck(), dismiss(). The real surface is pending() and recover(); this would not compile.
